description: Use this when the user wants quotes or bids from local contractors for a real job at a US property, or wants to re-bid an annual service contract. We email licensed, well-reviewed local contractors, follow up, and return a ranked comparison, usually within 48 hours. Price: $39 per job in USDC over x402. This tool checks the job and returns the exact paid HTTP request for your x402 wallet to send. Contract re-bids (contract_rebid job types) need incumbent_annual_usd. Not for price lookups: use check_fair_price.

contact_email.description: Optional: an email to notify when the comparison is ready. Agents can poll get_quote_job instead.

description.description: Scope in plain words: what's wrong, size/model, access notes, unit/building

incumbent_annual_usd.description: Current annual price (required for contract re-bids)

job_type.description: Job type id from list_job_types, e.g. water_heater_replace

title.description: Short title, e.g. 'Replace leaking 40-gal water heater'

name: request_quotes
title: Request contractor quotes
